title: PR 32434 - Remove labels from one stable selection
summary: Flow: Admin filter selects members, API takes one snapshot of matching IDs, one transaction removes selected labels. Problem: sequential filtering loses members after the first label removal. Fix: remove A and B from the same selected members. Review focus: capability-gated rollout, response validation and real database rollback.
